title: University Student Reportedly Received Zero After Turnitin AI Detector Flagged Essay

behaviors.text: An anonymized university [person] said Turnitin’s AI detector flagged 67% of an essay as AI-generated, despite the [person] claiming to have written the assignment by hand.
The [person] reportedly received a zero and said attempts to appeal to the professor, department head, and Turnitin support had not resolved the accusation.
